hypothesis.statement: PhysioWearable's computeENMO reproduces GGIR::g.applymetrics's ENMO on the identical hand-acceleration signal to MACHINE PRECISION (max absolute difference far below 1e-6 g, correlation 1.0 over the 749 five-second epochs); and the free-living summary built on that ENMO series yields a negative Rowlands intensity gradient (~-1.19), ~28.6 MVPA minutes, and an activity-to-sedentary fragmentation (ASTP ~0.113) on this ~1 h recording.

analysis_plan.dataset: PAMAP2 (UCI #231), subject 101, hand IMU +-16g acceleration @ 100 Hz; the first 374500 gap-free samples (749 five-second epochs, ~1.04 h), converted to g

decision.threshold: the FOUNDATION must match the reference: computeENMO vs GGIR max abs diff < 1e-6 g (machine precision) and correlation >= 0.9999; the free-living summary (intensity gradient, MVPA minutes, ASTP) then reproduces the case's per-recording numbers
